strat.text: 液氮储罐技术要求文档抽取经验（增补v2）：1.整机参数归属「储罐整体」部件；2.接口通径(DN)和验收管口规格(Φ外径×壁厚)分别用「通径」和「管口规格」区分，两者都要抽取；3.配套清单每个部件的规格和数量分成两条记录；4.英寸符号(")用「英寸」替代以保证JSON合法；5.环境条件（温度/风速/风压/地震烈度）不是设备部件指标不抽取；6.运输封存充氮压力、氮气露点属于设备要求可抽取；7.交货状态内容器保护气露点也需抽取；8.地脚螺栓规格、数量及配套件（螺母、垫圈）分别抽取；9.供液管道双阀要求、下进液管防涡装置等功能性要求也作为指标抽取；10.外罐/内罐/管道阀门材料分三条记录抽取；11.自增压器能力归属「自增压器」部件而非整体；12.表2配套清单中仅有数量无规格的条目只抽取数量一条记录；13.焊接检测要求（RT/PT检测比例、合格级别）按焊缝类型（A/B类、C/D/E类）分组抽取，归属「内罐焊接接头（X类）」部件；14.外增压进气管的DN通径和Φ管口规格均需抽取；15.充装法兰备注（含配套法兰及紧固件）也单独抽取一条。

液氮储罐技术要求文档抽取经验：1.整机参数归属「储罐整体」部件；2.接口通径(DN)和验收管口规格(Φ外径×壁厚)分别用「通径」和「管口规格」区分；3.配套清单每个部件的规格和数量分成两条记录；4.英寸符号用「英寸」替代以保证JSON合法；5.环境条件（温度/风速/风压/地震烈度）不是设备部件指标不抽取；6.运输保护参数和交货状态保护气露点属于设备要求可抽取；7.字段值内引号用中文引号「」。

{"title":"Structured Information Extraction from Industrial Technical Documents","use_cases":"Applicable when processing industrial technical documents (e.g., motor assembly drawings with parts lists, cryogenic/liquid nitrogen storage tank specs, satellite launch base equipment specs) containing multiple information layers (overall technical indicators, technical requirements text, parts/assembly lists). Triggered when goal is to output structured JSON records with fixed schemas (device–component–metric–characteristic–source) requiring all fields non-null. Also applies when compound entries need splitting, when user re-submits for format correction, table rows have empty cells requiring supplementation, or when multiple tables contain same-named components with distinct serial numbers.","hints":"1) Use multi-step framework: scan → self-review → revise → output. 2) Separate system-level from component-level indicators; use '整机' placeholder when no specific component applies. 3) Split compound parameters into one record per atomic metric. 4) For table rows with empty/'-' placeholder cells, skip record generation rather than supplementing — respect explicit null markers (context-dependent: follow user instruction). 5) Pre-define field attribution rules (整机 vs. 部件) before extraction; map technical requirements to the specific component they describe (e.g., rotor, bearing) rather than always assigning to 整机. 6) Retain duplicate-named components as separate records when they have distinct serial numbers — use original serial number as unique record identifier. 7) For quantity≥2 components, generate individual records per item to maintain 1:1 correspondence with source table rows. 8) Apply strict source fidelity: copy original text verbatim into source field. 9) Run final completeness check against all source sections before output. 10) When user re-submits, fully re-process rather than patch. 11) Pre-identify high-risk extraction points (empty fields, multi-value items, repeated component names across tables) before extraction.","confidence":"0.9"}

{"title":"Handling Incomplete or Empty Episode Submissions","use_cases":"Triggered when an episode submission contains empty or missing structured fields (goal, thought, action, reflection). Applies when there is insufficient context to extract meaningful behavioral patterns or tool usage insights. Relevant for any agent tasked with episode analysis or reflection generation that encounters malformed or blank input data.","hints":"1) When all structured fields are empty, do not attempt to fabricate patterns or insights — acknowledge the incomplete submission explicitly. 2) No reflection knowledge should be generated from empty episodes, as invented patterns reduce future agent reliability. 3) Flag the episode as unprocessable and recommend resubmission with complete data: clear user goal, step-by-step actions taken, tool calls made, and outcome/reflection notes. 4) Avoid treating absence of content as a pattern itself — one empty episode is not evidence of a recurring issue. 5) If multiple empty episodes appear across relevant episodes, that may warrant a meta-reflection about data collection quality upstream.","confidence":"0.5"}
